label: z1
evidence_boundary: Only TestCloneMetaStore is executed in Go; sharing scenarios are derived from read-only source, not runtime differential results.

scenarios.name: metadata_boundaries
scenarios.source: pkg/core/store.go StoreInfo.Clone and ShallowClone; pkg/core/store_option.go SetStoreLabels
scenarios.existing_test: TestCloneMetaStore: Equal Labels before mutation, NotEqual after changing Labels[0].Value
scenarios.expected: Clone owns distinct metadata; ShallowClone initially aliases; SetStoreLabels deep-clones metadata before replacement, leaving original zone=z1

scenarios.name: shared_stats_and_smoothing
scenarios.source: pkg/core/store.go Clone/ShallowClone copy s.storeStats; pkg/core/store_stats.go updateRawStats
scenarios.expected: After clone writes available=200/capacity=300 all handles observe it and the same HMA; shallow zero replacement resets raw values for all

scenarios.name: shared_limiter
scenarios.source: pkg/core/store.go NewStoreInfo, Clone, ShallowClone; pkg/core/store_option.go ResetStoreLimit
scenarios.expected: Both clones retain same limiter; resetting ADD_PEER rate to 7 is visible through original and shallow clone

scenarios.name: zero_value
scenarios.source: pkg/core/store.go Clone/ShallowClone field copies; pkg/core/store_stats.go GetAvgAvailable
scenarios.expected: Missing metadata and limiter stay absent, weights stay zero. Rust Default retains its preexisting valid empty stats holder (unlike literal Go StoreInfo{} with nil embedded stats); cloning shares that holder and leaves smoothing absent.

scenarios.name: concurrent_stats
scenarios.source: pkg/core/store_stats.go updateRawStats/GetStoreStats/GetAvgAvailable lock the common storeStats mutex
scenarios.expected: Concurrent reads see complete raw snapshots; after joined writer adds 100 identical available=123 samples all clones observe raw=123 and HMA=123; no timing-dependent expected ordering.
